text:
## Step 7: Account Status Change  
### System Updates  
**Changes Made:**
- Account status: "Active" → "Closed"
- Closure date recorded
- Closure reason documented
- Final balance recorded
- All standing orders/DDs marked "Cancelled"  
**Links Updated:**
- Customer profile: Account marked as closed
- Product statistics: Removed from active account count
- Fraud detection: Account excluded from monitoring
- Interest calculation: Stops at closure date  
**Access Restrictions:**
- No new transactions permitted
- Online banking access: Disabled
- Card (if issued): Automatically deactivated
- Standing orders/DDs: Blocked  
**Timeline:** Same day as final payment

raw_entities.name: Account Closure Process
raw_entities.description: End-to-end procedure for closing a customer account, including status transition from Active to Closed, system updates across customer profile and product statistics, recording of closure date and reason, and implementation of access restrictions. The process executes on the same day as the final payment and triggers automatic deactivation of associated payment instruments and cancellation of recurring payment mandates.
context: Timeline: Same day as final payment

raw_entities.name: Account Status Transition
raw_entities.description: System step that updates the account status from Active to Closed and records the closure date, closure reason, and final balance in the core banking system.

raw_entities.name: Recurring Payment Mandate Cancellation
raw_entities.description: System step that marks all standing orders and direct debits associated with the closed account as Cancelled and blocks any further execution of these recurring payment instructions.

raw_entities.name: Customer Profile Update
raw_entities.description: System step that updates the customer profile to mark the account as closed, ensuring the closure status is reflected in the customer's master record.
context: Customer profile: Account marked as closed

raw_entities.name: Product Statistics Update
raw_entities.description: System step that removes the closed account from the active account count in product statistics, maintaining accurate reporting of active product holdings.
context: Product statistics: Removed from active account count

raw_entities.name: Fraud Detection Exclusion
raw_entities.description: System step that excludes the closed account from ongoing fraud detection and transaction monitoring, as the account is no longer active and poses no operational risk.
context: Fraud detection: Account excluded from monitoring

raw_entities.name: Interest Calculation Termination
raw_entities.description: System step that stops all interest accrual and calculation on the closed account effective from the closure date.
context: Interest calculation: Stops at closure date

raw_entities.name: Online Banking Access Restriction
raw_entities.description: System step that disables online banking access for the closed account, preventing the customer from accessing the account through digital channels.

raw_entities.name: Card Deactivation
raw_entities.description: System step that automatically deactivates any card issued against the closed account, preventing further card transactions.

raw_entities.name: Transaction Block Implementation
raw_entities.description: System step that implements access restrictions on the closed account to prevent any new transactions from being initiated or processed.

raw_entities.name: Banking System
raw_entities.description: Automated system responsible for executing all account closure system updates, including status transitions, link updates, access restrictions, and recurring payment mandate cancellations.

raw_entities.name: Closed Account
raw_entities.description: A customer account that has transitioned from Active status to Closed status as part of the account closure process. The account is subject to access restrictions, transaction blocks, and exclusion from monitoring and interest calculation.

raw_entities.name: Standing Order
raw_entities.description: Standing order payment instructions associated with the closed account that are automatically marked as Cancelled and blocked from further execution upon account closure.

raw_entities.name: Direct Debit
raw_entities.description: Direct debit mandates associated with the closed account that are automatically marked as Cancelled and blocked from further execution upon account closure.

raw_entities.name: Debit Card
raw_entities.description: Payment card issued against the closed account that is automatically deactivated upon account closure, preventing further card transactions.
